mission_02: Label encoding assigns a unique integer to each category value. Unlike one-hot encoding, it produces a single column rather than multiple binary columns. Label encoding is appropriate for ordinal categorical variables where there is a natural ordering (like education level: High School < Bachelors < Masters < PhD). However, it can be misleading for nominal categories without ordering, as algorithms may interpret the numeric values as having mathematical meaning. In this mission, you will use sklearn's LabelEncoder to encode education levels and understand when this technique is appropriate.
